---
name: Docs improvement
about: A doc is wrong, missing, confusing, or out of date.
title: "docs: <short description>"
labels: ["docs", "good first issue"]
---

<!--
Docs fixes are some of the most-welcome contributions. They are a great first
PR.
-->

## Where

Which file and section? Link is ideal, e.g.
`README.md#quickstart` or `ARCHITECTURE.md` line range.

## What is wrong

What does the doc currently say (or fail to say)?

## What it should say

A short suggested edit. A pull request directly is even better.

## How you found it

What were you trying to do when the doc let you down?
